rationale: All observed FCIs (fci_n1, fci_n2, fci_n4) indicate fault current, so the fault must be at or downstream of n4. The only such section is s45 (n4->n5). A fault on s45 outages only the downstream customer n5, which matches the single outage complaint. Other candidate sections fail because a downstream FCI would not see fault current or the outaged customer set would differ.
